colorTransfer: Front-facing vertex colors projected from the approved transparent concept; sides/back use a soft spatial blockout.
limitations: The source is one mostly connected triangle mesh; spatial color masks are only a blockout.
Front projection is a review aid; pose differences cause distortion and it is not a final animated texture.
The generated UVs are for editing, not a finished fur or fabric texture layout.
No rig or weight groups are invented in this preparation step.
The source collection remains intact and hidden; only the work copy receives edits.
